pages.title: Share a Screen ID
pages.text: In Settings, enter a Screen ID and apply it to link displays.$(br2)Displays with the same ID follow the shared image, including across dimensions. Creating a network makes you its owner.

pages.title: Joining a Network
pages.text: Linking requires management rights for both this display and the destination network.$(br2)Matching IDs alone do not bypass another owner's access rules.

pages.title: Joining a Network
pages.text: Viewing and control policies belong to the linked network.

pages.title: Detach a Display
pages.text: Clear the Screen ID and apply it to detach this display.$(br2)It keeps its current image and ownership settings, but stops following the network.

pages.title: Detach a Display
pages.text: Screens with different ownership or access settings do not automatically merge.
